name: ego-lite-security-workspace
description: Cross-platform browser telemetry and authorized web security workspace for ego-lite

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ego-lite/security-core && npm run build --workspace @ego-lite/browser-adapter && npm run build --workspace @ego-lite/mcp && npm run build --workspace @ego-lite/desktop && npm run build --workspace ego-browser-v2
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @ego-lite/security-core && npm run typecheck --workspace @ego-lite/browser-adapter && npm run typecheck --workspace @ego-lite/mcp && npm run typecheck --workspace @ego-lite/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @ego-lite/security-core && npm run test --workspace @ego-lite/browser-adapter && npm run test --workspace @ego-lite/mcp && npm run test --workspace @ego-lite/desktop && npm run test --workspace ego-browser-v2
